phase: Phase 2B â€” Staff Identity and Historical Attribution Mapping Specifications
rule_order: first successful unique verified rung wins; conflicts fail closed

records.name: Pre-approved explicit Classic-to-target crosswalk
records.normalization: Exact protected keys; no textual normalization.
records.uniqueness_requirement: Exactly one active approved crosswalk row per Classic key and target key.
records.conflict_condition: Duplicate source/target claims or revoked approval.
records.target_existing_match_behavior: No target field changes; preserve target ID.

records.name: Unique verified employee/staff number
records.normalization: Authoritative issuer normalization defined by HR; no invented value.
records.uniqueness_requirement: Unique across source crosswalk and target.
records.conflict_condition: Mismatch between target user and employee identifiers.
records.duplicate_condition: More than one source or target.
records.classic_schema_presence: not present as verified Classic schema evidence; external protected HR input required

records.name: Unique verified professional registration number
records.uniqueness_requirement: One source person and one target person.
records.conflict_condition: Identifier absent from installed target representation or disagrees with HR.
records.manual_review_condition: required until an approved target field/crosswalk exists
records.classic_schema_presence: not present as verified Classic schema evidence; external protected HR input required

records.name: Unique verified organization email
records.normalization: RFC-valid organization-domain canonicalization; raw contact never enters specs.
records.uniqueness_requirement: Exactly one verified source and target.
records.conflict_condition: Unverified/personal address or target field conflict.
records.target_existing_match_behavior: Preserve target email; never send verification/welcome/reset.
records.classic_schema_presence: not present as verified Classic schema evidence; external protected HR input required

records.name: Verified multi-field employment identity
required_fields: at least two independently verified employment attributes
records.normalization: Field-specific protected comparison; names/usernames/phone/department alone or together without HR assertion are insufficient.
records.conflict_condition: Any constituent conflict or only weak Classic fields available.
records.classic_schema_presence: not present as verified Classic schema evidence; external protected HR input required

records.name: Manual HR review
records.uniqueness_requirement: One signed/approved decision record per source key.
records.target_existing_match_behavior: Existing target unchanged or historical candidate classified.

cross_rung_agreement_rule: All available authoritative verified identifiers must agree. Any disagreement between individually unique rungs quarantines the identity; a higher rung never suppresses contradictory verified evidence.
